from operator import length_hint
n = 10

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.it = iter(range(n))
    d = list(range(n))
    it = iter(d)
    next(it)
    next(it)
    assert length_hint(it) == n - 2, ('assertEqual', length_hint(it), n - 2)
    d.append(n)
    assert length_hint(it) == n - 1, ('assertEqual', length_hint(it), n - 1)
    d[1:] = []
    assert length_hint(it) == 0, ('assertEqual', length_hint(it), 0)
    assert list(it) == [], ('assertEqual', list(it), [])
    d.extend(range(20))
    assert length_hint(it) == 0, ('assertEqual', length_hint(it), 0)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
